name: California Custom Cable
old_description: California Custom Cable in Gardena is your leading provider of exceptional quality wire and cable products that are proven for unmatched performance and long-lasting durability. Whether it is minor cable work or major wiring project, our customized wires and cables are designed to adapt to your unique needs. We take pride in our service excellence and outstanding commitment to our customers. When you need heavy duty wires or lightweight cables, trust us to offer you timely and thorough assistance that saves you time and money.
about:
Founded in 2005, California Custom Cable has accumulated over two decades of experience in wire and cable manufacturing, operating from a Gardena, California location on West 180th Street.

The company specializes in producing wires and cables built to custom specifications, handling both minor cable work and major wiring projects. Its output includes medical cables and automotive cables, with the team managing design and assembly for clients that need non‑standard configurations. The shop emphasizes the use of high‑grade materials and runs each product through quality checks before shipment.

Customers come from the automotive and medical sectors, as well as hospitals and software companies. The firm says it helps these clients reduce cable costs by tailoring designs to exact requirements rather than relying on off‑the‑shelf products.

California Custom Cable states that its differentiation lies in personalized attention from knowledgeable staff, rigorous material selection, and a focus on delivering resilient, safe products for homes, businesses, and industrial environments. The company also highlights its friendly, professional team that works closely with customers to discuss service needs.
